cocoa-source-beppu-2013.locator: p789 abbreviation; p790 section 2.1 and positional-isomer footnote; p791 Fig.1
acceptedUses: β-POS uses oleoyl at the middle glycerol position and palmitoyl/stearoyl at the two outer positions.
Use a two-dimensional condensed connectivity sketch without an absolute sn or enantiomer assignment.
limits: β in β-POS is a glycerol positional label, not β₂ crystal packing.
C55H104O6 is derived by formal atom balance, not a new measurement or a model of cellular TAG synthesis.
Outer P/S exchange is accepted only because this diagram does not specify stereochemistry.

depth-cocoa-polymorph.locator: Chocolate Table 2 and Fig.5, PDF p6; chocolate preparation, DSC and bending methods, PDF pp7–8
acceptedUses: Four Table 2 chocolate groups, their means, SE, author compact-letter assignments and Fig.5 Form V assignment.
Keep the measured melting and protocol-defined bending quantities separate from molecular formula.
limits: Do not pool pure cocoa-butter Table 1 with chocolate Table 2.
DPPE and recrystallized share c for bending; preserve that table result despite broader narrative wording.
No raw force-displacement, XRD or replicate values were reconstructed; SE is not SD or a confidence interval.
A common Form V assignment does not establish identical microstructure, taste, storage stability, or causal shares.

limits: This activity does not complete every fat-bloom mechanism or claim whole-question coverage or points.

structureContract.name: β-POS
structureContract.representation: 2D connectivity; glycerol position 2 is middle; outer positions are not stereospecific sn labels
structureContract.formulaProvenance: element balance C3H8O3+C16H32O2+C18H34O2+C18H36O2−3H2O; calculated, not measured in the cited paper
structureContract.betaMeaning: β in β-POS labels glycerol positional connectivity; beta at middle glycerol carbon is distinct from beta2 crystal packing
structureContract.stereochemistry: No wedges/dashes, Fischer projection, R/S, or absolute sn assignment. Reversing the drawn outer P/S labels is accepted only at this connectivity level; it does not establish the equivalence of specified enantiomers.
structureContract.crystalBetaMeaning: β₂/Form V labels packing in cocoa-butter crystals; it does not change which acyl chains are ester-linked.

commercial-original.description: Fresh commercial chocolate directly from package

melt-recrystallize.note: Recrystallized control and additive groups share the reported thermal history. Additive groups also change composition; original commercial control has a different thermal history.

statistics.elasticBendingModulusAndWiN: 4–16 replicates, per-cell exact n not reported
statistics.sharedLetterMeaning: Within a metric row, shared superscript letter means not significantly different at the authors' P > 0.05 criterion; this is not proof of equivalence.
statistics.noSharedLetterMeaning: Apply authors' within-row compact-letter comparison; do not recalculate p values from mean and SE.
statistics.tableVsNarrativeConflict: Narrative describes recrystallized chocolate as significantly lower, but Table 2 DPPE (a,c) and recrystallized (b,c) share c. Preserve table and do not assert their difference is significant.

rawData.knownAttempt: Previous read-only public API attempt returned HTTP403; it was not saved as a source file. One ordinary request after the authorized source freeze returned HTTP200 with metadata. No raw dataset files or individual force-displacement arrays were downloaded.

limits: All four samples assigned Form V does not imply identical bulk or surface microstructure.
Table 2 is not a storage time course or a fat-bloom mechanism experiment.
Do not pool pure cocoa-butter Table 1, its 80°C/23°C protocol, or its metrics with chocolate Table 2.
No invented raw force-displacement, XRD intensity, microscopy, individual replicates, standard deviation, confidence interval, or p-value.
Do not rank sensory quality, safety, universal additive efficacy, or commercial recipe superiority.
Reported n is a replicate count and does not establish independent production batches.

exam.question: 食品化學第4題(1)(2)
exam.scope: New structure lesson partly supports (1). Crystal/evidence comparison provides prerequisite reasoning relevant to (2), not a complete fat-bloom mechanism answer.
exam.coverageClaim: No point/percentage coverage claim. Existing official source object preserved exactly despite its older Q1 publisher locator; this new audit and lesson examRefs give Q4-specific scope.

derivations: Acyl formulas equal the corresponding free acid minus OH.
TAG atom counts equal glycerol plus three free acids minus three waters.
Group mean differences are computed; relative differences are restricted to bending modulus with an explicitly chosen baseline.
No percentage change is emitted for Celsius temperatures because their zero is arbitrary.
